title: family_rule_set
description: Set a device adjustment of one manageable rule (data/family.json manageable_rules) on each listed child device, permanent (no expires/expires_at) or temporary (either expires, a preset of the profile model, or expires_at – not both: family_error invalid_request; data/profile-rules.json expiry_limits). Only rules not fixed in the child's profile and not decided by a boundary; areas only within the areas this device sees. A value equal to the profile value removes the adjustment. Last writer wins (also against the admin); every write is logged with the actor. Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_result; every changed child: family_child_updated to all its family managers, client_config_updated to the child.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.

client_ids.description: Child devices (e.g. all devices of one child). Each is checked on its own (family_result.results).
